description: My opponent, the incumbent, was not initially voted into office, but rather placed into office by two men she calls “Pillars of the Community” Senator Robert Martwick and John Arena, please.She has championed policies that have put our first responders and our citizens in harm's way, her latest victim Sheridan Gorman. Let’s look at her accomplishments since taking office in 2019, this is where we are at under her leadership.#1 in Highest Combined State and Local Taxes#1 in Highest Cell Phone Tax
title: Missing the Pointe
